name: chimpvibe
description: The games on chimpvibe.dev, one tag away — paste a fruit's tag (chimpvibe:ssnake#9) and Install / Ask about / Modify that exact build through the ONE server (chimpvibe.dev/mcp); the contribute wizard: fork → patch → validate → submit, then the owner deploys.

token.title: ChimpVibe member token
token.description: The token you minted at https://chimpvibe.dev/join (shown once). It is yours alone; it never leaves your machine except as the Authorization header to chimpvibe.dev. Stored in your Claude Code settings like any `claude mcp add --header` token.
